cleaningServices.label: Beyond cleaning, a flawless living space

title.highlight: You enjoy life, leave the cleaning to us.

cleaningServices.description: We provide professional cleaning services for homes, offices and corporate workspaces. With our experienced team, we make your living and working spaces hygienic, organized and safe.

assurance.title: The same care, quality and trust in every service.
assurance.description: With our experienced team and planned approach, we turn cleaning into an effortless experience.

hero.title: The same care for every space,
hero.highlightedTitle: the same standard in every service.
hero.description: From homes and offices to corporate spaces and post-construction cleaning, we develop tailored solutions for every need. With the right team, the right equipment and a planned working model, we turn cleaning into an effortless experience.

listen.title: We Listen to Your Needs
listen.description: We understand your space and expectations to determine the most suitable cleaning solution for you.

plan.title: We Plan for You
plan.description: We create the right team, equipment and work schedule according to your needs.

deliver.title: We Make the Difference
deliver.description: With our attention to detail, we leave your space clean, fresh and ready to use.

imageTrust.title: Novalis Standard
imageTrust.description: The same commitment to quality in every service

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To make living and working spaces cleaner, healthier and more comfortable while providing our customers with a reliable, planned and effortless service experience.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To redefine the standards of trust and quality in the professional cleaning industry by combining innovative technologies and a sustainable service model with a commitment to excellence.

story.title: We see cleaning not simply as a service, but as a well-designed experience.
story.description: Novalis was founded with the goal of making professional cleaning services more reliable, planned and accessible. We do not see cleaning as limited to on-site work; from quotations and appointments to team planning and quality control, we manage the entire process in a professional and trackable way.

values.title: Behind every service are
values.description: We shape our service quality not only through the final result, but through the working principles we follow at every stage of the process.

care.title: Care
care.description: We treat every space as if it were our own and work meticulously down to the smallest detail.

trust.title: Trust
trust.description: We deliver the service we promise on time, transparently and professionally.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.description: We prefer environmentally conscious products and cleaning methods that use resources efficiently.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: We maintain the same standard in every service and aim for results that are noticeable and trustworthy.

home.title: Home Cleaning
home.description: With our professional home cleaning service, we make your living spaces hygienic, organized and fresh.

office.title: Office and Workplace Cleaning
office.description: We provide professional cleaning services for offices and workplaces, creating clean, organized and healthy working environments.

postConstruction.title: Post-Construction Cleaning
postConstruction.description: We remove dust, dirt and residue left after construction and renovation work with our detailed cleaning service.

periodic.title: Periodic Cleaning
periodic.description: With our regular and planned periodic cleaning service, we help keep your home and workplace consistently clean and well maintained.

deep.title: Deep Cleaning
deep.description: With our detailed deep cleaning service, we thoroughly clean your living and working spaces, including hard-to-reach areas.
